# SD18 deterministic Human Wizard level 19 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Wizard
# level-1..level-18 prepared arcane spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/sd18_wizard_level18_widening.rs) to Wizard level 19 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic ability/feat posture from
# the level-1..level-18 fixtures, and the same canonical school
# specialization selections (Evocation chosen, Necromancy/Transmutation
# opposed), adding only the level bump this cycle needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Wizard burden surface: no evocation
# spell-damage application, no force-missile casting execution, no
# opposed-school preparation cost, no spellbook, no spells prepared, no spell
# slots, no spell DCs, no bonus-feat selection/execution for the
# still-unproven 5th/10th/15th/20th-level "Bonus feat" grants, and no
# level-20+ progression. Two PF1 CRB primary sources (d20pfsrd and the
# Archives of Nethys aonprd.com mirror) were read directly before writing
# this fixture, fetching the full levels-16-through-20 block in one pass so
# the level-19 row's neighbors were visible in context (guards against
# level-misattribution), and both agree byte-for-byte on all rows: base
# attack bonus STAYS at +9 (`19/2 = 9`, an integer-division coincidence with
# level 18) and good Will STAYS at +11 (`19/2+2 = 11`, also an
# integer-division coincidence with level 18), while poor Fortitude/Reflex
# both STAY at +6 (`19/3 = 6`, an integer-division coincidence with level
# 18).
# The raw Wizard spells-per-day table's level-19 row is
# "4/4/4/4/4/4/4/4/3/3" — up from the level-18 row "4/4/4/4/4/4/4/3/3/2" (the
# 7th-level column rises from 3 to 4 and the 9th-level column rises from 2 to
# 3); no genuinely NEW spell-level column opens at level 19 (9th is already
# the highest wizard spell level in PF1, first opened at level 17), so the
# specialist bonus-slot flat count (one bonus slot of each spell level she
# can cast, 1st through 9th) STAYS at 9, unchanged from level 17-18.
# Intense Spells' bonus-damage magnitude STAYS at 9 (`max(19/2, 1) = 9`, an
# integer-division coincidence with level 18) via the pre-existing formula,
# not re-derived; Force Missile's uses-per-day pool stays level-independent
# and unchanged; Scribe Scroll stays recognized as an already-held grant.
# The level-19 "Special" column is genuinely BLANK on both primary sources
# (the Wizard's own next bonus feat lands at 20th level, not 19th) — a pure
# ceiling raise, no new pillar record is grounded at level 19.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-wizard-level19-sd18-widening
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:wizard:19
ability=strength:8
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:17
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:wizard_school_specialization:school:evocation
choice=choice:wizard_opposed_schools:school:necromancy
choice=choice:wizard_opposed_schools:school:transmutation
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:intelligence
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/scope-draft.md
